title: Integer scaling for a nonempty restriction set
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ and let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a nonempty finite set. There is an integer $z$ such that the top restriction coefficient of $f$ on $J$ equals $z\,2(1/2)^{|J|}$.
